preprocessing: Input tensor contract: Raw [0.0, 255.0] float32 pixels. An internal Keras model layer tf.keras.applications.mobilenet_v3.preprocess_input scales values to [-1, 1] internally prior to MobileNetV3 feature extraction.
dataset_source: Dual-Domain Pure Solanaceae Corpus (PlantVillage Clean Subsampled + PlantDoc Outdoor Train)

held_out_unseen_outdoor_test.independence_statement: 100% cryptographically and crop/zoom excluded from training. Verified zero overlap via SHA-256 and multi-scale crop dHash. Each unique test specimen evaluated exactly once.

field_evaluation_plantdoc.notes: Empirically evaluated across PlantDoc Solanaceae partition with strict 80/20 hash-level holdout partition documented in ai_engine/PLANTDOC_HOLDOUT_MANIFEST.json.
field_evaluation_plantdoc.botanical_domain_gap_analysis: PlantDoc outdoor images capture whole plants from 1-2 meters away with soil, weeds, background foliage, and severe shadowing. This natural domain gap demonstrates why standalone closed-set CNN vision alone is insufficient, and why KRISHI-DRISHTI multi-modal close-up optical shroud (eliminating background void and harsh flash shadows) and conservative DHT11 microclimate telemetry gating (suppressing late blight chemical spray recommendations when RH < 85%) serve as essential multi-modal safety interlocks.

tflite_quantization.quantization_type: Float16 (FP16 Post-Training Optimization with Float32 input/output interfaces)
tflite_quantization.latency_benchmark: 4.94 ms Host PC CPU reference interpreter mean (Intel Core i5 with XNNPACK, range: 4.43-5.33 ms across classes); Target Mobile Edge: ~12-15 ms projected budget (Cortex-A55 engineering estimate, unprofiled on physical Galaxy A03 via ADB)
tflite_quantization.benchmark_environment: Host CPU Reference (Intel Core i5-4300U @ 1.9GHz with XNNPACK) - Target on-device mobile ~12-15 ms (Galaxy A03 Cortex-A55 estimate)

botanical_validation_60_specimens.cross_crop_pathogen_note: 1 Tomato Late Blight specimen was predicted as Potato Late Blight (cross-crop match, identical Phytophthora infestans pathogen). Under strict 6-class crop match, scored as non-match.

records_vs_unique_distinction: The model was trained using 7710 training records representing 6965 unique image files (6,600 clean PlantVillage + 370 clean PlantDoc repeated 3x = 1,110).
